events.title: Indian Shares Extend Gains For Second Day
events.description: Indian shares rose for a second consecutive session on Friday, with information technology stocks leading the surge as disappointing tech earnings fueled a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade globally.

events.title: French Stocks Mixed As Investors React To Earnings, Economic Data
events.description:
French stocks turned in a mixed performance Friday morning with investors reacting to corporate earnings announcements and the latest batch of economic data. 

Data showing an unexpected contraction and higher crude oil prices weighed on sentiment.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower On Interest-rate Concerns
events.description: Gold traded lower on Friday and was on course for a second consecutive monthly loss on concerns over rising crude oil prices and expectations of a Federal Reserve interest-rate rise in December.

events.title: Pound Rises Amid BoE Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday, as traders await the widely anticipated interest rate increase by the Bank of England next week.

events.title: Oil Prices Surge As Trump Weighs Fresh Military Action Against Iran
events.description: Oil prices were sharply higher on Friday on signs the U.S. may resume military strikes against Iran.

events.title: German Stocks Fall 0.41% As Energy, Tech Drag Despite GDP Surprise
events.description: Germany's DAX index declined 108.05 points to 25,931.63 following four consecutive days of gains. Rising oil prices and tech sector weakness from Amazon and Intel earnings weighed on the benchmark, while economic data showed stronger-than-expected Q3 GDP growth.

events.title: Pound Rises Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: Yen Rises On BoJ's Hawkish Pause
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, after the Bank of Japan left its key interest rate unchanged after a hike last month as underlying inflation is assessed to be consistent with the 2 percent inflation target.

events.title: European Shares Mixed In Cautious Trade Amid AI Investment Concerns
events.description: European stocks were mixed on Friday, after having closed at a seven-week high the previous day on the back of strong earnings and status quo interest-rate decisions by the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As AI Concerns Pressure Chip Stocks
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Friday, with tech and semiconductor shares falling amid ongoing AI-related concerns.

events.title: Yen Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: French Economy Shrinks Unexpectedly On Weak Investment, Exports
events.description: The French economy contracted unexpectedly in the third quarter on weak investment and exports, amid high borrowing costs and social unrest clouding the outlook. Gross domestic product fell 0.1 percent sequentially after stagnating in the second quarter, preliminary data from the statistical office INSEE revealed Friday. Economists had forecast the economy to expand 0.1 percent.

events.title: Bank Of Japan Holds Key Rate As Expected
events.description: The Bank of Japan left its key interest rate unchanged on Friday after a hike last month as underlying inflation is assessed to be consistent with the 2 percent inflation target. The policy board, governed by Ueda Kazu, voted 8-1 in favor of holding the interest rate at 1.25 percent, the highest since 1995.
